Honest Coffee Guide: Kingrinder K2 grind settings

procedure.en: Remove the catch cup. Turn the adjustment nut clockwise until you feel resistance; do not overtighten. Note the number under the triangle marker as your reference. Turn counter-clockwise and count clicks from there.
procedure.pt-BR: Remova o recipiente de pó. Gire a porca de ajuste no sentido horário até sentir resistência; não aperte demais. Anote o número sob a marca do triângulo como referência. Gire no sentido anti-horário e conte os cliques a partir dali.

notes: Internal adjustment (numbered dial under the burr), 40 clicks per rotation, 18 µm per click of burr travel (Kingrinder), not particle size. Honest Coffee Guide charts to 140 clicks (3.5 rotations). The manual: 'Do not rotate the handle when the grind setting is at 0 or below 16 clicks.' K1 shares the official chart and Honest Coffee Guide chart with K2. Official values are single numbers, so the official band is a point; use the community range to move within it. Zero tolerance of 2 clicks is not stated by Kingrinder; it mirrors the K6.
